text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp—a time for honing 
one's skills. Yet, Seiun Sky seems utterly 
obsessed with sea fishing instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While keeping an eye on her rival's 
movements for the time being, Seiun Sky 
headed to the rocky shore for a quick spot 
of fishing first.
